details: Bitcoin dipped below $74,000, with Ethereum and Solana also experiencing declines, following hotter-than-expected inflation data in the US. This has fueled concerns among investors regarding potential interest rate hikes and a stronger US dollar, creating a challenging environment for digital assets. Reports also indicate continued outflows from crypto ETFs.
title: Crypto Markets Decline on Hot Inflation Data

details: Deutsche Bank has officially launched a regulated digital asset custody service for institutional clients in Europe. The service supports Bitcoin, Ethereum, and three stablecoins, operating under the European Union's MiCA framework. This move is seen as a significant step towards integrating cryptocurrencies into traditional finance, with plans for future expansion into tokenized assets.
title: Deutsche Bank Launches Regulated Crypto Custody for Institutions

details: New global cryptocurrency regulations, including MiCA and the Financial Action Task Force's (FATF) Travel Rule, are becoming more stringent, making compliance a critical factor for crypto firms seeking market access and expansion. The SEC has also provided further clarity on its analysis of decentralized governance and functional networks, impacting how projects are classified.
title: Global Crypto Regulations Tighten, Compliance is Key for Businesses

details: Despite a 20% drop in Ethereum's price, the staking exit queue has dramatically decreased by over 85% since October, indicating that stakers are largely holding their positions rather than withdrawing to sell. However, a slowdown in new staking demand and increasing borrowing against staked ETH are presenting potential liquidation risks.
title: Ethereum Stakers Maintain Positions Amid 20% Price Decline

details: On November 10, altcoin spot Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced net outflows, with Solana (SOL) and XRP seeing the most significant declines. This trend marks consecutive days of outflows for these specific altcoin ETFs, reflecting a cautious investor sentiment and potentially impacting their market capitalization and trading volumes.
title: Solana and XRP Lead Altcoin ETF Outflows on November 10
